story.text: 서면 노래방, 조명이 어지럽게 돌아가는 작은 방에 우리 둘뿐이다. 선우가 리모컨을 붙잡고 신나게 번호를 누른다.
story.reading: seo-myeon no-rae-bang, jo-myeong-i eo-ji-reop-ge dol-a-ga-neun jak-eun bang-e u-ri dul-ppun-i-da. seon-u-ga ri-mo-keon-eul but-jab-go sin-na-ge beon-ho-reul nu-reun-da.
story.en: In a Seomyeon karaoke room, lights spinning dizzily, it's just the two of us. Sunwoo grabs the remote and excitedly punches in a number.

story.text: "이 노래 예약했다, 내가. 니는 다음 곡 골라 놔라." 그가 노래책을 휙 넘기며 곡 번호를 눈으로 훑는다.
story.reading: i no-rae ye-yak-haet-da, nae-ga. ni-neun da-eum gok gol-la nwa-ra. geu-ga no-rae-chaek-eul hwik neom-gi-myeo gok beon-ho-reul nun-eu-ro hult-neun-da.
story.en: "I already reserved this song. You pick the next one." He flips through the song book, scanning the numbers.

story.text: 전주가 흐르자마자 선우는 마이크를 꽉 쥐고 눈을 감는다. 애창곡이 분명하다. 가사 하나 틀리지 않고 열창한다.
story.reading: jeon-ju-ga heu-reu-ja-ma-ja seon-u-neun ma-i-keu-reul kkwak jwi-go nun-eul gam-neun-da. ae-chang-gok-i bun-myeong-ha-da. ga-sa ha-na teul-li-ji anh-go yeol-chang-han-da.
story.en: The moment the intro starts, Sunwoo grips the mic tight and closes his eyes. It's clearly his signature song. He belts it out without missing a single lyric.

story.text: 점수가 뜨자 그가 두 팔을 번쩍 든다. "98점! 봤제? 내가 이 방 레전드다." 능청스러운 표정에 웃음이 터진다.
story.reading: jeom-su-ga tteu-ja geu-ga du pal-eul beon-jjeok deul-da. 98-jeom! bwat-je? nae-ga i bang le-jeon-deu-da. neung-cheong-seu-reo-un pyo-jeong-e us-eum-i teo-jin-da.
story.en: When the score pops up, he throws both arms in the air. "98 points! See that? I'm the legend of this room." His deadpan pride sends me into laughter.

story.text: 내 차례가 되자 선우가 탬버린을 흔들며 분위기를 띄운다. "박자 놓쳐도 괜찮다, 흥만 있으면 되는 기라!"
story.reading: nae cha-rye-ga doe-ja seon-u-ga taem-beo-rin-eul heun-deul-myeo bun-wi-gi-reul ttui-un-da. bak-ja noch-yeo-do gwaen-chan-ta, heung-man iss-eu-myeon doe-neun gi-ra!
story.en: When it's my turn, Sunwoo shakes a tambourine to hype up the mood. "It's fine if you miss the beat, all that matters is having the vibe!"

story.text: 우리는 목이 쉬도록 신청곡을 부르고 또 불렀다. 마지막 곡이 끝나자 화면에 이용 시간이 다 됐다는 안내가 뜬다.
story.reading: u-ri-neun mok-i swi-do-rok sin-cheong-gok-eul bu-reu-go tto bul-leot-da. ma-ji-mak gok-i kkeut-na-ja hwa-myeon-e i-yong si-gan-i da dwaet-da-neun an-nae-ga tteun-da.
story.en: We sang requested songs until our voices went hoarse. As the last song ended, a message popped up on screen saying our time was up.

story.text: "십 분 더 넣자." 선우가 미련 가득한 얼굴로 동전을 찾아 주머니를 뒤진다. 나는 웃으며 그의 손을 말렸다. "내일 목 다 쉰다, 그만해라."
story.reading: sip bun deo neot-ja. seon-u-ga mi-ryeon ga-deuk-han eol-gul-lo dong-jeon-eul chaj-a ju-meo-ni-reul dwi-jin-da. na-neun us-eu-myeo geu-ui son-eul mal-lyeot-da. nae-il mok da swin-da, geu-man-hae-ra.
story.en: "Let's add ten more minutes." Sunwoo, looking reluctant to leave, digs through his pockets for coins. Laughing, I stop his hand. "Your voice will be totally gone tomorrow, that's enough."

words.meaning: to reserve, book (a song, a table)
words.example_en: I reserved a requested song at the karaoke room.

words.meaning: one's signature song, favorite song to sing
words.example_en: This song is my signature song.
The karaoke score was over 90 points.
At karaoke, having the vibe matters most.

words.meaning: for one's voice to go hoarse
words.example: 노래를 너무 많이 불러서 목이 쉬었다.
words.example_reading: no-rae-reul neo-mu man-i bul-leo-seo mok-i swi-eot-da
words.example_en: I sang so much that my voice went hoarse.

sentences.en: I reserved my favorite song ahead of time.
This song is his signature song.
The score came out high, so I got excited.
The vibe matters more than the rhythm.
I sang so excitedly that my voice went hoarse.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이 노래 예약했다, 내가. 이거 완전 내 애창곡이다.
turns.reading: i no-rae ye-yak-haet-da, nae-ga. i-geo wan-jeon nae ae-chang-gog-i-da.
turns.en: I already reserved this song. This is totally my signature song.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: I'm looking forward to it. Let's see how high your score comes out.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 각오해라, 내 진지하게 부를 거다. 박수는 나중에 쳐도.
turns.reading: gak-o-hae-ra, nae jin-ji-ha-ge bu-reul geo-da. bak-su-neun na-jung-e chyeo-do.
turns.en: Get ready, I'm going to sing this seriously. Save the applause for after.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Okay, got it. Go ahead and start.

dialogues.question: 선우가 노래방에서 부르려는 노래는 어떤 곡인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What kind of song does Sunwoo plan to sing at the karaoke room?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 자신의 애창곡을 미리 예약해 놓고 진지하게 부를 준비를 합니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: 98 points, that's seriously a total legend.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 봤제? 내 실력 인정하나? 이제 니 차례다.
turns.reading: bwat-je? nae sil-lyeok in-jeong-ha-na? i-je ni cha-rye-da.
turns.en: See that? Do you acknowledge my skills? Now it's your turn.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 나는 자신 없는데. 박자도 잘 못 맞추고.
turns.reading: na-neun ja-sin eop-neun-de. bak-ja-do jal mot mat-chu-go.
turns.en: I'm not confident though. I can't even keep the beat well.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 박자 놓쳐도 괜찮다, 흥만 있으면 되는 기라! 내가 탬버린 쳐줄게.
turns.reading: bak-ja noch-yeo-do gwaen-chan-ta, heung-man iss-eu-myeon doe-neun gi-ra! nae-ga taem-beo-rin chyeo-jul-ge.
turns.en: It's fine if you miss the beat, all that matters is having the vibe! I'll play the tambourine for you.

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객에게 노래를 부르라고 격려하며 한 말은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo say to encourage the passenger to sing?
dialogues.correct_answer: 박자를 놓쳐도 흥만 있으면 된다고 했다
options: 박자를 놓쳐도 흥만 있으면 된다고 했다
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 박자보다 즐기는 흥이 중요하다며 승객을 편하게 격려해줍니다.
